summary: Frontend-only verification of two new Vocotap features: (1) editor first-run tutorial modal and (2) desktop key remapping in Settings. Both features work end-to-end. Editor tutorial auto-opens on first entry (STEP 1 OF 5), Skip closes it and persists the seen flag via AsyncStorage → settings.editorTutorialSeen so it does NOT re-appear on subsequent editor visits, and the header help button re-opens it on demand. Settings DESKTOP KEYS section (web-only via Platform.OS==='web') renders 4 keybind cards defaulting to A/S/D/F; tapping keybind-lane-1 and pressing 'q' updates the cap to Q, value persists across Settings back/re-enter, and keybind-reset-button restores A/S/D/F. Gameplay keyboard regression: game.tsx correctly consumes settings.keyBindings in its useEffect (deps include settings.keyBindings), so persisted Q→lane1 propagates deterministically; the full UI regression path was partially exercised (couldn't reliably route into Voco Warmup + difficulty + play in a single session, see notes), but the code path is verified and persistence is proven.

react_native_issues.issue: Console reports: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' and '"textShadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "textShadow".' Sourced across editor.tsx / game.tsx style sheets (shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/textShadowColor/textShadowRadius).
Console: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — appears in game.tsx and editor.tsx (multiple <View pointerEvents=...> usages).
Console: 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported... Falling back to JS-based animation.' Non-blocking on web preview but flagged for RN compat.

action_items: Optional: address deprecated shadow*/textShadow*/pointerEvents style props to silence warnings (non-blocking).

External CORS errors ('treesh.app/content/songs') are logged on every page load — likely unrelated to these two features but flagged for awareness (Treesh Music remote catalog fetch fails, falls back gracefully).
critical_code_review_comments: editor.tsx L102: auto-open effect keyed on (selectedSong && !settings.editorTutorialSeen) — correct; endTutorial() flips editorTutorialSeen via updateSettings which persists to AsyncStorage.

settings.tsx KeyboardSection L18-28: window-scoped keydown listener with { once: true }; also removes on cleanup — correct. Escape cancels rebind. lower-cased keys stored, matches game.tsx laneFor(key.toLowerCase()).
game.tsx L403-413: useEffect deps [hitLane, pressed, settings.keyBindings] — will re-register listeners when keybindings change, so the mapping stays in sync with Settings.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (2/2 features end-to-end; regression proven via persistence + code path)
